findings.title: Manual dispatch lacks exact-SHA CI verification
preconditions: Exact candidate files; all transport replaced with QA doubles; temporary files only.
reproduction_steps: Feed the real Validate release shell a merged SHA and an API fixture with failed CI.
The compare endpoint says identical; execute actual step without SSH/deployment.
findings.expected_result: Refuse missing/failed exact-SHA CI gates before SSH deployment; documented explicit exception requires owner decision.
findings.actual_result: Exit0 and skip=false; only compare…develop queried; no CI status inspected.
findings.limits: Local shell/API/Git failure injection only; not proof of current host exploitation or disruption.

findings.title: Cached image tag accepted despite another revision label
preconditions: Exact candidate files; all transport replaced with QA doubles; temporary files only.
reproduction_steps: Use local real Git origin/develop with synthetic merged commit.
Return cached image inspect success with revision=b*40 for both requested tags.
Run the real gate; inspect build/deploy transport trace.
findings.expected_result: Refuse or rebuild and verify wrong-revision images; release state alone cannot attest running code.
findings.actual_result: Gate exits0, no rebuild, invokes release deploy. Conditional on stale/mistagged local images; no live image tampering performed.

findings.title: Existing matching CI key silently remains unrestricted
preconditions: Exact candidate files; all transport replaced with QA doubles; temporary files only.
reproduction_steps: Generate a valid synthetic Ed25519 key in temporary fixture.
Seed the child authorized_keys with that public key without options.
Run bootstrap with fake Docker and isolated HOME.
findings.expected_result: Refuse or safely constrain a preexisting unrestricted matching key; never announce gate-only setup while unrestricted entry remains.
findings.actual_result: Bootstrap exits0 and leaves unrestricted entry. Actual sshd session not tested; precondition is an already unrestricted reused key.

findings.actual_result: Exit1 and claims previous configuration, but active is candidate and persisted is old.

findings.title: Unbalanced marker drops an existing host while safety guard passes
preconditions: Exact candidate files; all transport replaced with QA doubles; temporary files only.
reproduction_steps: Seed syntactically valid original containing BEGIN without END and a later literal api.qa.invalid host.
Run real attach with completely fake Docker/curl and inspect candidate.
Independently adapt original and candidate using official checksum-verified Caddy2.10.2.
findings.expected_result: Reject malformed markers before mutation; preserve every non-LawDesk host; require complete nonempty health baseline.
findings.actual_result: Exit0; original adapts with app/api hosts, candidate adapts with app/LawDesk and no api. Literal-host discovery yields no probes. No actual shared proxy touched.

findings.title: Rollback smoke uses failed release manifest
preconditions: Exact candidate files; all transport replaced with QA doubles; temporary files only.
reproduction_steps: Create QA release directories A/B with distinct manifests and actual scripts.
Seed current=A and force B up failure.
Inspect target=A rollback up and smoke exec -f arguments.
findings.expected_result: Both rollback up and smoke verification must use target A own release contract/manifest.
findings.actual_result: up uses A/compose.yaml but smoke exec uses B/compose.yaml with tag A. This is distinct from fixed QAD-013.
